newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-BOUDOUANI BEATS DANIELS TO RETAIN TITLE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-BOUDOUANI BEATS DANIELS TO RETAIN TITLE.

text.p: Coming on strong in the later rounds, Laurent Boudouani made a successful first title defence of his World Boxing Association junior middleweight crown by beating former champion Carl Daniels on Saturday.
Boudouani scored the only knockdown in the fight in the eighth round after knocking Daniel's mouthpiece flying in the sixth round.
In the final moments of the 11th round, Boudouani wobbled Daniels with a flurry of punches that had the American challenger holding on at the bell.
"He was hitting me with some good shots,"Daniels said.
Boudouani won the last six rounds on one judge's scorecard and won five of the final six on the other two scorecards.
Judge Marcial Vargas scored it 118-108 for the Frenchman while Melchior Taylor had it 115-111 and Duane Ford 117-109.

Daniels had a point deducted by referee Richard Steele for spitting out his mouthpiece on purpose early in the final round before Boudouani sent the mouthpiece flying with a solid blow later in the round.
Daniels was trying to reclaim the title that he had lost to Argentine Julio Cesar Vasquez in 1995. Vasquez lost the crown to Boudouani last year.
Boudouani is 35-2 and Daniels fell to 38-3.
